description: Trust and safety facts of one AppForShare Android store listing of this workspace: whether the listing is taken down (kind REPORT after credible reports, COPYRIGHT or TRADEMARK after a complete notice, STAFF; the public note, and whether the owner can still dispute a report takedown once in the Store tab), releases AppForShare marked unsafe (the kill switch: the public reason, the source RESCAN = the weekly malware rescan matched, REPORT = a rescan started by a malware report matched (the number of reports never marks a release unsafe), STAFF; whether it was live, in which case it is out of the store and the F-Droid compatible repository lists it as KnownVuln so clients warn people who installed it), copies at Google Play or the App Store the author must pull there by hand (AppForShare never removes them), recent reports on the listing (category, the text with links removed, date and what the automatic triage did; never who reported), and copyright or trademark notices (status DISABLED = waiting for the one response of the developer, with evidence, RESPONDED = the sender may reply once within 10 business days, DECISION = AppForShare decides Restore or Keep down, RESTORED, KEPT_DOWN = upheld, WITHDRAWN, REJECTED; sender, work, claimed infringement, the decision reason, whether it counts as upheld), whether the store account is closed (three upheld notices in 12 months) and the upheld count, and the newest asset originality check (outcome PASS, HOLD = waits for proof from the Store tab, REJECT = a famous brand or another live app icon or package id without ownership proof; reasons with the addresses found, attribution notes for free stock images). Nothing comes back on a timer. Reports, rescans and complete notices are decided automatically; a disputed notice is decided by AppForShare; staff can override. Responses and disputes are sent from the Store tab or the mailed link, never from here. Read only. Every plan with an account.
